items.concept: open and closed balls depend on the metric, not only on the underlying set

items.concept: convergence names a limit; Cauchy only measures tail tightening
items.inspection_target: hover over tail values and compare present versus missing limits

items.validation: tail diameters decrease below recorded thresholds

items.concept: epsilon-delta continuity is equivalent to pulling open sets back to open sets
items.inspection_target: trace which local ball is chosen from an open target ball
items.representation: domain/codomain interval diagram and proof dependency graph
items.validation: computed delta sends sampled domain points into the epsilon target ball

items.concept: compact metric sets admit finite control; noncompact examples leak to a missing endpoint
items.inspection_target: read coverage radius on [0,1] and see the open-interval sequence approach 1
items.representation: finite epsilon-net coverage and missing-limit sequence sketch
items.validation: KDTree nearest-center distances stay below epsilon on the sampled compact interval
